=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1263-1334 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The echo-substitution validator does not apply read-only host and URL restrictions to inner `gh api` calls.
  WHY: A read-role command can use an inner GET targeting a non-GitHub host and pass the echo path; minimax_minimax-m3 reports that the latest implementation closes this path, while the other reviewers report that the helper and parameter are absent.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1465 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Outer `gh api` invocations remaining after echo rewriting are classified without a read-only host restriction.
  WHY: A non-GitHub outer GET in a command containing an approved echo substitution can be classified as a read and allowed.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1504-1508 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The inline read-only check does not reject absolute or protocol-relative endpoint URLs.
  WHY: These URLs leave `parsed["hostname"]` unset, allowing a GET to an attacker-controlled host to pass; minimax_minimax-m3 reports that the latest implementation closes this path.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:281-284 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The read-profile environment does not unset `GH_HOST`.
  WHY: An inherited `GH_HOST` can route a relative-looking GET to a non-GitHub host while the guard sees no parsed `--hostname`; minimax_minimax-m3 reports that the latest implementation unsets it.
- tests/test_ai_engine.py:40 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The credential-name test list omits `GH_HOST`.
  WHY: The test does not verify that read-role Claude children strip `GH_HOST`.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1554-1561 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The read-only fallback denial is reached only after earlier approval paths have had a chance to return.
  WHY: The echo and approvable-command paths can allow requests before the fallback runs, so it does not act as a final denial gate.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "API writes, absolute URL endpoints, GraphQL calls, HEAD requests and unapproved compound commands are denied by the read-profile hook, including in echo substitutions"
  expected_change_site: `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` read-only checks in `evaluate`, `_approved_echo_read_command`, and the post-rewrite outer-invocation classification
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` at lines 1263, 1329-1334, 1458, 1463-1465, and 1504-1508 lacks the reported shared read-only gate; `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py` at lines 983-1017 lacks the cited URL and echo-host cases; the workflow-template copy is reported in the same state.
- requirement: "compound commands are denied by the read-profile hook, including in echo substitutions."
  expected_change_site: `_approved_echo_read_command` and outer-invocation classification in `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: `_approved_echo_read_command` lacks read-only host and URL gating; the call site does not pass a read-only parameter; the outer classification at line 1465 has no read-only gate.
- requirement: "Give read-role model processes a read-only GitHub identity and a GET-only API wrapper; deny all API writes in their hook policy."
  expected_change_site: `scripts/ai_engine.sh` credential setup and the workflow identity provisioned for read-role runs
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: `scripts/ai_engine.sh` strips write-capable credentials but does not provision a read-only identity; README.md:1997-2000 documents that private-repository reads are unavailable until one is provisioned.
- requirement: "cleared GH_HOST prevent saved logins and host overrides from restoring access"
  expected_change_site: `scripts/ai_engine.sh:281` credential_prefix and `tests/test_ai_engine.py:313-317` credential_names list
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: `scripts/ai_engine.sh:281` lacks `-u GH_HOST`; `tests/test_ai_engine.py:314` omits `"GH_HOST"`.
- requirement: Test coverage for the new read-only guard contracts (absolute URLs, protocol-relative URLs, GH_HOST clearance, echo-substitution compound commands with alternate hosts)
  expected_change_site: `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py` read-only test functions and `tests/test_ai_engine.py` `test_read_profile_strips_credentials_from_claude_only`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: The cited read-only tests lack the URL, alternate-host echo, and compound-command cases; `credential_names` omits `"GH_HOST"`.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  severity=BLOCKER confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The inline read-only check does not detect absolute endpoint URLs or protocol-relative URLs.
  WHY: Such endpoints leave `parsed["hostname"]` as None and can pass the check as readable GET requests.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py
  Line or code reference: 1263 (signature), 1458 (call site), 1329-1334 (inner validation)
  severity=BLOCKER confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_approved_echo_read_command` has no `read_only` parameter or inner hostname and URL validation.
  WHY: An alternate-host GET inside an echo substitution can be accepted by the inner validation and outer echo-acceptance gate.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py
  Line or code reference: 1465
  severity=BLOCKER confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Outer `gh api` invocations after echo rewriting are classified without read-only restrictions.
  WHY: An outer alternate-host GET in a command with an accepted echo substitution can be allowed.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh
  Line or code reference: 281
  severity=BLOCKER confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `credential_prefix` does not unset `GH_HOST`.
  WHY: An inherited host override can redirect GET requests while the guard sees no `--hostname`.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "API writes, absolute URL endpoints, GraphQL calls, HEAD requests and unapproved compound commands are denied by the read-profile hook, including in echo substitutions" (changelog lead paragraph)
  Expected change site: `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` — `_read_only_get_allowed` helper function, updated inline check in `evaluate` per-invocation loop, `_approved_echo_read_command` signature and body, echo-substitution call site, and outer-invocation classification after echo rewrite
  Evidence of absence: `_read_only_get_allowed` function does not exist anywhere in the repository (grep across all `.py` and `.sh` files returns zero matches). `_approved_echo_read_command` at line 1263 has signature `(command: str)` with no `read_only` parameter. The call at line 1458 passes no `read_only`. The inner validation at lines 1329-1334 checks only method and GraphQL status. The outer-invocation classification at line 1465 calls `classify()` directly with no read-only gating. The inline check at lines 1504-1508 uses three explicit conditions without URL-scheme or protocol-relative prefix checks.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "cleared GH_HOST prevent saved logins and host overrides from restoring access" (changelog lead paragraph)
  Expected change site: `scripts/ai_engine.sh:281` credential_prefix and `tests/test_ai_engine.py:313-317` credential_names list
  Evidence of absence: `scripts/ai_engine.sh:281` reads `credential_prefix=(env -u GH_TOKEN -u GITHUB_TOKEN -u GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN -u GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN` with no `-u GH_HOST`. `tests/test_ai_engine.py:314` lists `"GH_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN", "GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN", "GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN", "GH_PAT",` with no `"GH_HOST"`. Grep for `GH_HOST` across the entire repository returns zero matches.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Test coverage for the new read-only guard contracts (absolute URLs, protocol-relative URLs, GH_HOST clearance, echo-substitution compound commands with alternate hosts)
  Expected change site: `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py` parameterized test functions at lines 983-999, 1002-1008, 1011-1017; and `tests/test_ai_engine.py` `test_read_profile_strips_credentials_from_claude_only` at line 308-333
  Evidence of absence: `test_read_only_denies_writes_including_routine_writes` (line 983-999) has no cases for `gh api https://example.com/...`, `gh api https://api.github.com/...`, or `gh api //example.com/...`. `test_read_only_keeps_approved_reads` (line 1002-1008) has no `gh api --hostname github.com ...` or `gh api ... && echo "$(gh api ...)"` compound case. `test_read_only_denies_unapproved_or_non_get_reads` (line 1011-1017) has no echo-substitution alternate-host, absolute-URL, protocol-relative-URL, or compound alternate-host+GET cases. `test_ai_engine.py` credential_names at line 314 omits `"GH_HOST"`.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py
  Line or code reference: 1554-1561
  severity=MAJOR confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The approvable-command and read-loop returns occur before the read-only fallback denial.
  WHY: The fallback cannot act as a final gate for calls that have already passed an earlier approval path.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION
  File: tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py
  Location: between lines 1017 and 1019 (after the existing read-only test functions)
  Issue: Missing regression test for the read-only hook process (`subprocess.run` with `--read-only`) on a valid payload — the existing subprocess tests at lines 960-980 test the interactive hook process, but the read-only hook process test (`test_read_only_hook_process_fails_closed_on_invalid_payload`) only tests an invalid-payload path.
  Suggested minimal fix: Add a `test_read_only_hook_process_allows_approved_read` that runs `[sys.executable, str(GUARD_PATH), "--read-only"]` with input `{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"gh api repos/o/r/pulls/1"}}` and asserts `permissionDecision == "allow"`.
  Estimated lines changed: 12
